label: CONNECTION

cover.headline: Staying close *with little kids at home*
cover.sub: 5 small ways when you’re both running on empty.

points.heading: Go easy on yourselves
points.body: This season is busy, and closeness can look different for a while. That’s okay.
points.panel: “Let’s count the small moments right now. They matter.”

points.heading: Use the in-between minutes
points.body: A hug in the kitchen counts. So does a text during nap time.

points.heading: Trade one evening a week
points.body: One of you handles bedtime while the other rests, then switch.
points.panel: “Can we take turns with bedtime so we each get a break?”

points.heading: Talk about more than logistics
points.body: Ask one question a day that isn’t about schedules.

points.heading: Name what you miss
points.body: Gently saying it helps you both make room for it.
points.panel: “I miss just sitting with you. Can we plan a little time?”

close.save: Save this for the tired weeks.

caption:
With little ones at home, it’s easy for a marriage to turn into a well-run household and not much else.

That’s normal in this season. Closeness doesn’t need long date nights right now. It needs small, steady moments that remind you you’re still a team, and still a couple.

Save this for the tired weeks, and follow @spotseason for more small steps.
